cargo.source: ORIGINAL: VEH/Rogue.veh Hornet (vehicle 2000) f[48] StopWeight; NEW: read as the hold's hard weight cap.

hyper.source: ORIGINAL: VEH/Rogue.veh Hornet terrain 0 HyperThrust f[209]=55, BackwardHyperThrust f[211]=-1, HyperTopSpeed f[208]=3500, HyperEnergyCost f[373]=1100.

source: Derived by OriginalShipBuilder from RPG/Rogue.rpg row 4 (skill 8), VEH/Rogue.veh row 18 (vehicle 2000), category 'Ship Hull - Terran'. Flight: OriginalShipPhysics (G10 emulator reading, mass 100 is a NEW scale); terrain 0 StrafeThrust f[207]=22, independently converted by the emulator reading. Hull points: VEH f[6]=50, raw. Radius: VEH f[35] PhysicalRadius=21 px. Energy: VEH f[94] EnergyMax=1700, f[95] EnergyRate=1050 (tenths per second, OriginalEnergyScale); f[96] EnergyStart=1700 equals the maximum. Shield: the energy itself (CFG EnergyShieldMode=2, NWS/Rogue.nws rows 39-41 and 131). Starting weapon: VEH f[129] 'addinv=Plasma Cannon' (ITM id 1004).
newValues: Hull points used raw (f[6]); weapon hull damage reads ITM thousandths, so a Plasma Cannon hit takes 5 of the Asp's 50 (unvalidated in play).

Energy recharge 105/s and boost cost 110/s read f[95] and f[373] as tenths per second (the recharge items' 'kj/s' wording); recharge pausing while the boost is engaged is the owner's rule, not original data.

Boost thrust and top speed (HyperThrust, HyperTopSpeed, BackwardHyperThrust -1 = HyperThrust) use the RollThrust/RollTopSpeed units; no emulator code reads them. Releasing Shift clamps the ship back to its normal top speed.
Terrain blocks other than open space (0) are not applied yet (F12), for flight or boost.
Strafe: independent lateral acceleration with no diagonal normalization and normal thrust during boost is NEW/provisional; the original player evaluator and physical keys remain unverified.
